metadata.description: Historical alert-episode labels for the ADR 0010 null-model backtest windows (2007-2009, 2020, 2023). Curated by an automated Stage 8 pass and validated only against the offline schema contract: no human review or labeling has occurred, and independent historical verification is pending. Supplies outcome-side labels and window inventories only; it never scores precision or lead time and never opens the null-model gate. Legally distinct cases can share one macro shock: the proximate March 2023 Silicon Valley Bank, Signature, First Republic and Credit Suisse contagion family is grouped wholly in the train split, while the held-out 2023 cases are intentionally different families, so Stage 9 must report family sensitivity and must not treat these correlated cases as independent draws.
metadata.provenance: Automated Stage 8 curation and contract validation. No human authorship, labeling or review; independent historical verification pending. Onset prose is original paraphrase from public institutional records.

labeling.positive_rule: Positive iff the declared target risk outcome materialised inside the case's one selected horizon bucket: outcome.occurred is true and actual_start_date falls in that bucket, with at least one adverse outcome class, sourced to outcome-supporting refs. Date-normalization convention: where an authoritative source dates a turning point only to a calendar month or quarter (for example NBER's monthly business-cycle chronology), actual_start_date and actual_end_date store the first day of that labeled month as an explicit representation convention; the stored day denotes the labeled month, not an observed calendar day.
labeling.control_rule: Control is a stressed near-miss: a real alert condition was present at evaluation_as_of but the declared target outcome did not occur inside the selected bucket through evaluation_end, evidenced by control-supporting refs.
labeling.label_timing: Labels are knowable only on label_available_on, on or after evaluation_end; onset and indicators use only evidence observable on or before evaluation_as_of.
labeling.onset_outcome_separation: Onset holds only as-of-observable evidence with no hindsight, future year, outcome class or outcome date; outcome and control text are separate and never inputs.
labeling.controls: Controls carry a substantive rationale and control-supporting sources; actual dates and classes stay null/empty. This is an automated pass with no human review, independent historical verification pending.
labeling.lead_time: Lead time is computed downstream from actual_start_date relative to evaluation_as_of; it is never stored here, and horizon labels are buckets, not thresholds.

source_policy: Only authoritative primary, institutional or statistical https sources (regulators, central banks, governments, official filings, and BIS/IMF/World Bank/OECD/WHO/NBER/FRED and equivalents). No blogs, encyclopaedias, media summaries or placeholder URLs.
